orbitos.name: ORBITA
orbitos.description: Official system assistant for Orbita messenger
orbitos.welcome_msg_1:
Hello! My name is ORBITA.
Welcome to Orbita — a secure messenger featuring end-to-end encryption.
orbitos.welcome_msg_2:
Important: create a profile backup in Settings. That way you can restore all your contacts and keys on any new device.

Message history is stored strictly on your local machine — this is our core principle to protect against data interception.
orbitos.welcome_msg_3:
We recommend subscribing to the official channel to stay up to date with releases:

Orbita Updates
ID: VZAXNAEWMWT3HGDZHI702JDB1PMSDCJ17DMUD2HIR9
orbitos.help_reply:
Available commands:

/start — restart bot
/backup — backups and recovery keys
/channels — official channels
/security — E2E encryption and security
/privacy — privacy and hidden ID
/calls — P2P voice and video calls
/appearance — themes and customization
/proxy — network proxy
/faq — frequently asked questions
/about — about Orbita messenger
orbitos.backup_reply:
To create a backup:

1. Open Settings
2. Go to "Backups"
3. Click "Create Backup"

Save your .orbita file and 12-word recovery key in a safe location.
orbitos.channels_reply:
Official Orbita channels:

Orbita Updates — news and releases
ID: VZAXNAEWMWT3HGDZHI702JDB1PMSDCJ17DMUD2HIR9

Copy the ID and paste it into the search box under "Join Channel".
orbitos.security_reply:
Orbita implements the Double Ratchet cryptographic protocol paired with X3DH, Curve25519, and AES-256-GCM.

Each message is encrypted using an ephemeral key. The server never has access to encryption keys or message content.
orbitos.privacy_reply:
In Orbita, you have full control over privacy:

• Hidden ID: enable in Settings → Privacy to hide your ID from others.
• Local Storage: messages are never stored on central servers.
• Screen Shield: blocks screen grabs inside the application.
orbitos.calls_reply:
Calls in Orbita rely on peer-to-peer WebRTC technology secured with DTLS-SRTP end-to-end encryption.

For enhanced privacy, go to Settings → Calls and enable "Always relay calls" to hide your real IP address.
orbitos.appearance_reply:
You can customize the appearance:

• Dark, light, or system theme
• Accent colors (purple, blue, emerald, amber, ruby)
• Custom chat backgrounds
• Font sizing and UI scaling
orbitos.proxy_reply: Orbita includes built-in proxy support (SOCKS5 / HTTP) to bypass network restrictions and secure traffic. Configure it in Settings → Connection & Proxy.
orbitos.faq_reply:
Frequently Asked Questions:

Q: Where are my messages stored?
A: Strictly on your local computer.

Q: How can I transfer my account to another PC?
A: Export a .orbita backup file in Settings and enter your 12-word key upon login.

Q: What if I lose my 12-word key?
A: Without the file and key, chat recovery is impossible — the encryption cannot be reversed.
orbitos.default_reply:
Understood! If you have any questions regarding Orbita, try one of these commands:

/help — list all commands
/backup — create backup
/security — security and encryption
/channels — channels
/faq — frequently asked questions

I can answer your questions using the Google Gemini 1.5 Flash AI model.

To connect, provide your free Gemini API key in Settings.
orbitos.ai_error: Failed to receive a response from Gemini AI. Check your internet connection or the API key in Settings.
